title: Conway
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Conway
learningObjectives: State the four rules that decide whether a cell lives or dies based on its count of live neighbors
Calculate the next generation of a small grid by counting each cell's 8 surrounding neighbors
Explain why the Game of Life is classified as a cellular automaton, with a discrete grid, discrete time steps, and purely local rules
Identify recurring patterns such as still lifes, oscillators, and gliders as they emerge from a random starting grid
Explain how complex global behavior emerges from simple local rules applied simultaneously to every cell
